claims: Johor Bahru is the capital of Johor, Malaysia.
Johor Bahru borders Singapore.
Johor Bahru is the second-largest city in Malaysia.
Johor Bahru is the southern tip of Peninsular Malaysia.
Johor Bahru serves as a major land border crossing with Singapore.
The land border crossing at Johor Bahru with Singapore is often called the busiest in the world.
Johor Bahru features Legoland Malaysia Resort.
Johor Bahru features Danga Bay.
Johor Bahru features Sultan Abu Bakar State Mosque.
Johor Bahru features Paradigm Mall.
Johor Bahru features Istana Besar (Grand Palace).
Johor Bahru features Johor Ancient Temple.
Johor Bahru features Gunung Pulai Recreational Forest.
Johor Bahru features the Blue Lake.
Johor Bahru was originally a small fishing village named Tanjung Putri.
Johor Bahru was renamed Johor Bahru in 1866.
Johor Bahru grew rapidly in the early 20th century.
Johor Bahru is linked to Singapore by a causeway.
Johor Bahru is preparing for a new rail link expected around the end of 2026.
Johor Bahru is a mixture of Malay, Chinese, and Indian cultures.
Laksa Johor is a food option in Johor Bahru.
